name: Paneer Mushroom Skillet
ingredients: ½ tsp dried oregano or chilli flakes
steps: Dry-sauté the mushrooms in a hot skillet for 5 minutes; set aside.
Heat the oil, then fry the garlic for 30 seconds, and the onion and capsicum for 3 minutes on high heat.
Add the paneer and brown for 2 minutes.
Return the mushrooms with the soy sauce, pepper and oregano; toss for 2 minutes.
Season with salt and finish with coriander.
note: A quick one-pan dish; the mushrooms and paneer both give umami.
